scenarios.title: On a build pinned to a fork release with patch/hard-reload-load-failed, in a newly created run-owned profile_<32hex> partition only: open a Native pane on a loopback page served with Cache-Control max-age; Browser menu shows Hard Reload (not the unavailable note); clicking it and pressing Mod+Shift+R each reload at the unchanged URL, the server logs Cache-Control: no-cache and Pragma: no-cache, and the page shows the fresh response

Same build and run-owned profile: typing a closed loopback port in the address bar shows Page could not load with the engine error and keeps the typed address; after the port starts serving, clicking Retry loads it and clears the error; a self-signed HTTPS loopback URL shows the certificate error without any certificate override

Same build and run-owned profile: start a navigation to a never-accepting loopback port, then navigate to a working page before it fails; the working page stays with no error overlay, and closing the pane during a pending navigation leaves no resurrected view or late error
